a.xlink:title: Operator that acts on a network's slots over one block at a time.
Produces every slot's signal for the block.
Turns slot blocks into published outputs.
Defines one slot's block as a function of other slots' blocks.
General operator whose body is a callable, run once per block.
Moves a single active slot along the rows of a weight table.
Domain-agnostic interpretive lens for network processing.
